settings.description: Path to the OpenColorIO config file. Set OCIO to your studio or project config path (e.g. /path/to/config.ocio). This is the standard $OCIO environment variable recognised by all OCIO-aware applications.
Default colour parameters used when a node has no explicit OCIO Color Parameters input. Every value ships as <default>, which means the OCIO config's own answer is used.

default_working_space.title: Working space
default_working_space.description: Colourspace or role that scene-linear pixels are in. <default> uses the config's scene_linear role.

default_display.title: Display
default_display.description: Display device to view through. <default> uses the config's default display.

default_view.title: View
default_view.description: View to apply on the chosen display. <default> uses the config's default view for that display.

fallback_config.title: Fallback config
fallback_config.description: Config to use when $OCIO is unset, as an ocio:// URI such as ocio://cg-config-latest. Filesystem paths are rejected: set $OCIO to point at your own config. <default> leaves colour management disabled.
